_comment: Single source of truth for model pricing. Add a model = add one line under models. $ per million tokens (list price). Matched by model-id prefix, most specific first (object key order is the match order). Cache reads bill at cacheReadMultiplier x input; cache writes bill by TTL via cacheWrite.
_cacheWriteComment: Cache writes bill by the TTL requested on the cache_control block: 1h = 2x input, 5m = 1.25x. Transcripts report the split under usage.cache_creation; when only the flat cache_creation_input_tokens is present the collector bills it at the 5m rate (the API default TTL).
_tiersComment: Optional per-model long-context tiers: [{ "above": <input tokens>, "in": <mult>, "out": <mult> }], applied when a message's total input tokens exceed `above`. Every model below is deliberately tier-free: Claude 4.6 and later include the full 1M-token context window at standard pricing (a 900k-token request bills at the same per-token rate as a 9k one). Do not add a speculative tier — an invented multiplier overstates cost just as badly as a missing one understates it.
_sonnet5Intro: claude-sonnet-5 is on introductory pricing ($2/$10) through 2026-08-31; it reverts to $3/$15 on 2026-09-01. bin/pricing.check.mjs fails once that date passes so the rate cannot go stale silently.
